import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    s, t = input[0], input[1]
    distinct = set()
    
    for i in range(1, len(s) + 1):
        for j in range(1, len(t) + 1):
            distinct.add(s[:i] + t[:j])
    
    print(len(distinct))

main()
